analysis_block_rationale: One-minute per-window-relative blocks are a fixed profile choice made before any scored-case analysis to retain temporal resolution in Bank's 30-minute windows. The same grain applies to metric contrasts and native-log composition. Fine blocks provide more test units but need explicit multiple-testing control; block aggregation alone does not guarantee statistical independence.

log_token_normalization.description: Bounded normalized token text plus a SHA-256 motif digest is retained for explainable row-local template matching; raw log lines, stack traces, and high-cardinality identifiers stay local. These motifs are not session event sequences and do not infer event success or cross-record order.
